visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a finished soup inside a bright orange pumpkin-shaped cast iron pot. Large slices of light green cucumber, white meatballs, and dark shiitake mushrooms are visible in the bubbling clear broth. (2) A woman with black-rimmed glasses, wearing a white t-shirt and a red apron, prepares ingredients. She places dried mushrooms in a metal tray and pours water from a glass measuring cup to soak them. (3) She slices ginger on a yellow cutting board and cleans raw pork ribs in a stainless steel bowl of water. (4) In a bright studio kitchen, she adds the cleaned ribs, soaked mushrooms, ginger, water, sake, and a strip of kelp into the orange pumpkin pot. (5) She uses a fine mesh strainer to skim the foam from the boiling soup, then covers it with the matching orange lid. (6) The woman peels a large yellow-green cucumber, removes the seeds with a spoon, and slices it into thick semicircles. (7) She makes cross-shaped cuts into white meatballs and adds them along with the cucumber slices into the pot. (8) After the soup is finished, she serves it into a white bowl seasoned with pepper and sesame oil. (9) The woman tastes a piece of cucumber and a meatball using a wooden spoon and chopsticks, reacting with a joyful expression and giving two thumbs up at the end.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a bright, upbeat acoustic guitar and percussion BGM. A splash sound is heard as water is poured. The female narrator greets the audience with a high-pitched, enthusiastic tone. (2) A rhythmic thudding sound follows as ginger is sliced on a board. The narrator explains the steps clearly with a friendly, professional cadence. (3) A distinct mechanical click and popping sound occurs when a lid is closed or opened. The BGM maintains a steady major-mode tempo. (4) Bubbling sounds of boiling water are layered with the narrator's instructions on simmering and skimming the soup. (5) A crisp crunching and slurping sound is heard as the narrator tastes the finished soup, followed by a happy exclamation with a rising pitch contour. (6) The video concludes with a synthesized 'ding' effect and a final professional call-to-action as the music swells and fades.
